decisions.reason: Requiring delivery of editable source files for self-service PDF export does not change the existing requirement to include fonts, icons, and reusable design assets in the final package.
The self-service export workflow relies on editable source files but does not change which customer-specific fields must be editable or their formatting.
The separate DX18 and DX19 wording decision in message 65 is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY; the self-service export change requires no additional narrative update.
The export workflow does not alter the required DX17–DX20 variants, their editability, or their score-and-risk selection basis.
Delivery of editable source files for independent PDF export does not change the content or presentation of front-page result drivers.
The self-service export workflow does not change the scoring-summary table or its required fields.
The source-file delivery and export decision does not change the vehicle identifier or its clean report-line presentation.
The new export workflow does not modify the approved visual theme, design direction, or cross-variant consistency requirements.
The self-service export decision does not alter the approved shared copy or assessment-date text rules.
Independent PDF export from editable source files does not change footer presence or required footer content.
The source decision does not change the front-page result fields, heading, prominence, spacing, or visibility.
The editable-source export workflow does not modify internal-page header coverage, content, or presentation.
